svg.title: Heat map: day x documentary family, automated provider-origin AI roles
svg.desc: A grid of 33 documentary families by 30 UTC days, shaded by the number of automated provider-origin AI GET 200 requests.
svg.text: Heat map: day x documentary family, automated provider-origin AI roles
Population: main documentary population, GET 200, stored tier provider_origin_verified_actor, roles ai_training and ai_search
combined. User-initiated fetches are left out of this daily view by the small-cell policy.
Unit: requests per UTC day and family. Built from the joint aggregate, never from marginals.
Hatching marks unavailable observations, never zero. Families are those of the scope registry; the right-hand number is the family total
Edition 2026-09-15_2026-10-15-r2. Data September 15 to October 14, 2026 inclusive, UTC (end exclusive 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z).
Extracted 2026-10-16 22:57 to 22:58 UTC; coverage: archive reports partial (declared) on 30 of 30 days.
